sources.title: Piracy monthly report for April 2026（ANNEX：Acts of piracy and armed robbery allegedly committed / attempted against ships）
sources.text: While the tug boat towing barge was underway, the Chief Officer noticed a sampan and two perpetrators sighted onboard the barge. The perpetrators subsequently left the barge and escaped in the sampan. Some scrap metal were stolen. The crew were not injured. The vessels continued their voyage, with the master declaring that no assistance was required. The incident was reported to Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore (MPA) (flag State). Singapore Port Operations Control Centre (POCC) confirmed that this information has been shared with the Republic of Singapore Navy's (RSN) Maritime Security Task Force (MSTF), Singapore Police Coast Guard (PCG) and Indonesian authority.
